title: Cap. IV Arg. 5 Sol: eternal destinatio κατὰ τὴν εὐδοκίαν — not according to foresight of faith
pass_a_gloss: Nor does it avail anything for confirmation of the Major, that there is no adoption into sons, except through faith. For although there be no adoption except through faith, there is nonetheless an eternal destination of certain persons unto adoption, according to the good pleasure of his will, Eph. 1:5, and not according to the foresight of our faith.
pass_b_english: And it does the Major no good to say there is no sonship-adoption except through faith. Grant the point: there is still an eternal destination of certain persons unto adoption according to the good pleasure of his will (Eph. 1:5), not according to foresight of our faith.
source_text: Nec facit quicquam ad confirmationem Majoris, quod nulla est adoptio in filios, nisi per fidem. Nam licet nulla sit adoptio nisi per fidem, est tamen aeterna destinatio certarum personarum εἰς υἱοθεσίαν, κατὰ τὴν εὐδοκίαν τοῦ θελήματος αὐτοῦ, Eph. i. 5. et non secundum praevisionem fidei nostrae.
